title: RNA-Seq ACSS2 KD Control
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Isolate total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract cellular RNA using the RNeasy® Mini Kit (Qiagen, catalog number 74104) following the kit’s instructions.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Analyze the isolated RNA on an Agilent Bioanalyzer to determine RNA integrity and quantify concentration.

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑Seq libraries
steps.instruction: Use 200 ng of the total RNA as input for library construction with the NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit (New England Biolabs GmbH, Germany) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Evaluate library quality
steps.instruction: Measure the quantity and quality of the generated libraries using an Agilent BioAnalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Load the libraries onto an Illumina NovaSeq instrument and sequence to obtain approximately 35 million paired‑end reads per library, each read 100 bp long.
